title: Abelian complex presentation of a cohomology cocone
statement: Let $I$ be a small cofiltered category, $H:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathbf{Ab}$ and $B$ a cocone on $H$. An abelian complex presentation is the following existential proposition. There are a diagram $X:I\to\mathbf{Sch}$, a limiting cone $c$, qcqs stages and affine transitions; complexes $F_i$ of abelian etale sheaves with a uniform lower bound $a$ and unital, coherent pullback maps $\varphi_f:f^*F_i\to F_j$; a diagram $G$ of complexes on $c.\mathrm{pt}$, isomorphisms $G_i\cong c_i^*F_i$ intertwining its maps with the $\varphi_f$, and a colimiting coefficient cocone $L$; an integer $p$ and canonical cohomology pullback maps $P$ fixed by the derived-adjunction unit and the global-sections composition comparison; isomorphisms $e_i:H_i\cong H^p(X_i,F_i)$ and $e_B:B.\mathrm{pt}\cong H^p(c.\mathrm{pt},L.\mathrm{pt})$. The $H$ transitions equal $e_i$ followed by $P$, cohomology of $\varphi_f$, and $e_j^{-1}$. The $B$ legs, followed by $e_B$, equal $e_i$ followed by $P(c_i)$ and cohomology of $e_{G,i}^{-1}$ followed by the coefficient cocone leg. The equations are the displayed canonical equations of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-limit-complex-systems]. The proposition does not assert that $B$ is colimiting and defines no selected witness.
